notes.title: Update 16.01.2015
notes.notes:
As you may have noticed, a new update has been released. Here is a list of changes included:

- fixed an issue preventing you from advancing after taking the "package for a friend" quest if you run out of money.
- restored a misplaced tooltip in Urgune
- fixed the issue preventing you from leaving the city in certain situations
- fixed the issue that made leaving Parnu impossible in Winter
- pressing ESC no longer cancels the customs window
- fixed the problem with repairing your carts in certain circumstances
- you can now buy oil in Vane Hoz in parts and still complete the "Enemy of my enemy is my friend" quest
- you can no longer repair more carts that you afford for
- added options in-game
- added keyboard shortcuts (list below)
- you can now disable the notifications about brigde tolls in the options
- added quick save (F5) and quick load (F8)
- fixed the issue that prevented you from leaving the monk in the ruins
- fixed the issue that made Air-partner quest markers invisible
- Added a new monster to the mine
- Fixed the NO TRANSLATION FOUND in "Like a fish caught in net" quest
- other minor fixes and improvements

List of keyboard shortcuts:

M - Market
W - Workshop/Shipyard
P - Palace
H - Townhall
T - Tavern
A - Airport
S - Seaport
C - Cantor
L - School
N - Shrine
R - Storage
O - Massage Parlour

E - Partner exchange
B - Book
G - Goods
Q - Quests

ESC - Close popups
F5 - Quick save
F8 - Quick load

Have fun!

- Achievement "the mole" is now unlocking properly

notes.title: Update 18.11.2014
notes.notes:
Another week, another update! 

Here is the list of changes:

- Mermaid quest is not going to show up in winter and late autumn to avoid getting stuck
- Issue with saves and black screen fixed
- Fixed the bug with item Stone Mask of Influence
- Fixed the endless profit bug reported by players

- Added a warning when time for competing a time sensitive quest is running out.
- Modified the prices of low level goods to make early game even easier
- Fixed the issue with ranking up quest when you have to start a partnership but you dissolved it before the quest.
- Issue with the first quest when sometimes you gathered more than 4000 golds but the game did not accept it
-  Added a feature that was requested. A travel log with previous prices
- Added a wait function for your trader. You can now order your trader to wait in the city for a given time.
- Fixed the bug with incorrect tax for the weight of goods.
- Added a set of tips for players who do not multiply their wealth two times in the first 100 days of the game.

notes.title: Full Release!!!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We have some news. Last Fridays' update was the last that this Early Access game is ever going to see...

...because we're having a full premiere Today that's why. Yup, Merchants of Kaidan is leaving it's infancy and entering adulthood. We would like to hereby thank all of you who supported us with your feedback, constructive critique and kind words. If it weren't for you we would not be where we now are.

A premiere of course does not mean that there won't be any future upgrades. On the contrary. We will be listening to your voices on the support email and on Steam game forums and work just as hard on developing the game even further. So don't hesitate to share your ideas and feedback.

We decided to not change the price of the final game and what's more to celebrate the release we're having a 33% off sale

notes.title: Update 31.10.2014 - we're getting there
notes.notes:
We're glad to announce that we are getting closer to the final release, yay! One of the main events of this week is the release of the demo version. It's made up from a one year scenario and gives enough of the gameplay to get a grasp what's the game about.

Here is the list of changes in this update.

- changes to events popping up when traveling from and into the Magnus Inn
- added new side quests
- repaired the possibility to exchange specialists when you meet one on your way
- repaired the bug when you could not travel between Siltarra and Varerg
- fixed the weirdly wraped text in the quest Madman of Science and Uncles from abroad
- repaired half a heart quest
- fixed the Merchant's whisper quest
- added the compensatory receipt after confiscation of arms
- fixed the issues with negotiator specialist incorrectly calculating the discount
- disabled arms confiscation event is not triggering while traveling by air and sea
- fixed the issue when a sargeant appeasred after leaving the foreman in the mine
- raised the income from mines and ruins
- lower the effect of stone idol on barbarian prices
- lots of other minor fixes and improvements

notes.title: Update 26-07-2014

- Troubles with traveling between cities
- Problems with unresponsive GUI and game screen going out of focus
- Game freezing after about 45-60 minutes of playing
- Corrupted saves and missing gold when returning to a saved game
- Minor non-game-breaking bugs that were a result of a rollback to a previous build.
